transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with really distressing, intrusive memories and flashbacks of a traumatic event that happened about a year and seven months ago. It often feels like I'm reliving the whole thing all over again, and I just can't seem to make it stop.
Have you been avoiding places, people, or activities that remind you of the trauma?

Yes, I... I've been avoiding a lot of things lately. I completely refuse to go near the part of town where it happened, and I've even stopped seeing certain friends because being around them just brings all those awful feelings right back.
Have these symptoms been happening for more than a month?
Yes, absolutely. They have been going on for much longer than just a month. It's actually been happening for about a year and seven months now, pretty much ever since the event occurred.

No new information has emerged to suggest an alternative diagnosis, and the current symptoms strongly support PTSD.
